test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of ₹717 becomes ₹874.74 in 5 years at a certain rate of simple interest. If the rate of interest is increased by 3.1%, then what will be the simple interest (in ₹) of ₹717 in 5 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = ₹717

Total Amount after 5 years = ₹874.74

Rate of interest increase = 3.1%

Time = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal × Rate × Time / 100

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

Amount = Principal + SI

⇒ ₹874.74 = ₹717 + SI

⇒ SI = ₹874.74 - ₹717

⇒
